consequences: Long text edits are restored by hand; coordination changes go through the task and lock commands.
context: The activity log shortens strings over 200 characters to <N chars>, so undo wrote the placeholder back; undo also replayed claims and locks without fencing or overlap checks.
decision: Undo refuses (CONFLICT) when an old value was compacted, and refuses claim, release, complete and lock activities and tasks held by another actor. Rejected: storing full values in every diff, which grows the log on each body edit.
title: Undo refuses compacted text and coordination writes
